title: Good Morning, Maple Street School

title: Rules for Show and Tell
text:

Rule one: You may bring one thing from home. It must fit inside a {noun}. Last year someone brought a {animal}, and that was too much. Rule two: Hold your item up high and talk {adverb}. Tell three facts about it. Rule three: Do not bring anything that might {verb} during class. This includes alarm clocks and {plural noun}.

title: Picture Day Instructions
text:

title: My Science Fair Project
text:

Next, I dropped it in and watched {adverb}. At first nothing happened. Then it {past tense verb} and turned {color}. My dad said, "Wow, that is {adjective}!" I did the test three more times. Every time, it smelled a little bit like {food}.
